tutorial: Basic_TechDraw_Tutorial.md (a page, a view at scale 2, a vertical and a horizontal dimension, the title block, an annotation; then an ANSI B page with a projection group at 2:1 and a length dimension on the isometric view that reads foreshortened until linked to the 3D model). Part A follows it on the tutorial's own part; part B is a small plate for the tools the tutorial does not reach.
reference: github.com/FreeCAD/Examples: Basic_TechDraw_Tutorial_Example_Files/Basic_TechDraw_Tutorial.fcstd (on the Mac: the reference copy: Basic_TechDraw_Tutorial.FCStd)

notCovered: td_bim: needs a BIM section plane (bim_section); belongs with the BIM model

td_dim type angle, td_dim_special chamfer_h / chamfer_v: neither part has a chamfer or a slanted edge worth an angle (the tutorial part's sloped face would do for angle in its Left view: td_geometry { view: "Left", kind: "lines" } and two edge names)
td_view_more broken, draft, image, symbol, share, move, clip_add: need break sketches, a Draft object, an image or SVG file; lock, stack and clip are run
td_lines align_h / align_v and style: left out to keep PlateTop's numbers steady for the calls after them
td_title presets (save, delete, import, export): they write to the person's own presets file
linking a dimension to the 3D model (TechDraw LinkDimension: References3D, MeasureType True), the tutorial's last step: no td_ tool does it; td_dim_special axo_length is the stand-in
TechDraw's own PDF / SVG export of a page (TechDrawGui.exportPageAsPdf / exportPageAsSvg): window only, not a td_ tool
the window: views appearing on the page tab as they are made (the hidden-line thread and the wait) is exercised by every td_view here, but that the page tab repaints is a look, not a reply
